name: Jethro Adebisi
bio:
co-lead developer and admin, 
 I’m a UX designer who spends a lot of time trying to make Web3 feel a bit less overwhelming. Some days that means rethinking how governance tools work; other times it’s sketching out flows for NFT platforms or small blockchain education projects that need clearer paths for beginners. I like the challenge of taking ideas that usually sound complicated on paper and turning them into interfaces people can actually use without guessing what’s going on.I wouldn’t say I have all the answers, but I try to design in a way that gives users more confidence and maybe nudges communities toward better participation. I’m drawn to projects that aim for transparency and trust, even if they don’t always get it perfect, because those small improvements tend to matter the most in the long run.
